proposed_widenings.name: relative_granted_spell_area_override
proposed_widenings.justification: grant_spell_access can override a spell's area with a fixed shape, but it cannot express a relative multiplier against the granted spell's own normal area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."

notes: Encoded as a composite magic item with passive worn benefits plus a once-per-dawn Web cast at fixed DC 13. The only omitted rider is the unsupported relative area multiplier on the granted Web.
